meta.title: Blog publisher
meta.description: Lets the model publish Markdown blog posts to GitHub and open a pull request that triggers the site deployment. It provides blog_preview, which builds the site to check rendering, and blog_publish, which commits the document together with its asset folder onto a topic branch, pushes it, and opens the pull request. It never pushes to the base branch, never merges, and refuses when the working tree holds unrelated changes.
